editorial:
If you love over-the-top comedy that pushes every boundary, you are in for a wild ride. Sacha Baron Cohen plays Admiral General Aladeen, a ridiculous dictator from the fictional country of Wadiya who travels to New York to address the United Nations. When he gets replaced by a look-alike, he ends up lost in the city with no power, no money, and no beard. The whole vibe is loud, silly, and completely unfiltered, with jokes coming at you from every direction.

The standout here is Cohen's fearless performance, as he commits fully to every absurd moment. The pacing never slows down, and the supporting cast keeps things moving. On the downside, some jokes miss the mark and the humor is definitely not for everyone. If you enjoy edgy, anything-goes comedy, you will have a blast. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Aladeen reveals his true identity during a speech at the UN, tearing up a fake democratic constitution and declaring Wadiya a dictatorship again. The twist is that he actually falls in love with Zoey, the activist who helped him, and they end up together. He keeps his power but also becomes a slightly better person, showing that even a ridiculous dictator can find love while staying true to his over-the-top self.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves boundary-pushing comedy and Sacha Baron Cohen's style of humor.
